about: Best-per-need lists. Each need is one read-only SQL query over the fshy store that returns rid plus the columns named in sort. The wiki renders them at /need/<id>/, the API at /api/v1/need/<id>, the MCP tool `need` and `fr need` run the same text. Duplicates (record.duplicate_of) are excluded by default. A list of free offers reads the claim has-free-tier (num 1: a free allowance is stated), or leaves out a record whose own summary opens with 'no free'; never free_unit, which is the unit of the headline offer and which a paid plan carries too. A row whose sort value is NULL is listed after the ranked rows, under 'no parsed number', never dropped. A self-hosted record (record.self_hosted = 1) is the last resort: its rows come after every hosted row, ranked or not, so the order is self_hosted, then the sort value with NULL last, then the verdict.

needs.title: Free S3-compatible storage, no card
needs.scope: Usable storage offers with a stated free allowance, in the storage topic or in egress, with an S3 interface whose identity requirement was read and does not include a card. A paid plan with no free allowance is not listed. Sorted by USD per TB-month where a price parsed.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, usd_per_tb_month FROM record WHERE (topic='storage' OR (topic='egress' AND interfaces LIKE '%s3%')) AND grp='usable' AND (interfaces LIKE '%s3%') AND needs_card=0 AND identity_basis='stated' AND duplicate_of IS NULL AND rid IN (SELECT rid FROM claim WHERE kind='has-free-tier' AND num=1)

needs.title: Bulk storage by price per TB-month
needs.scope: Storage offers with a parsed price per TB-month, usable or paid-only, cheapest first. Prices in other currencies are converted only with a dated exchange rate that a record cites.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, usd_per_tb_month FROM record WHERE topic='storage' AND grp IN ('usable','paid') AND usd_per_tb_month IS NOT NULL AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Free storage with no card
needs.scope: Usable storage with a stated free allowance, in the storage topic or in egress with an S3 interface, with a stated identity requirement that is not a card, best verdict and strongest evidence first. A paid plan with no free allowance is not listed.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE (topic='storage' OR (topic='egress' AND interfaces LIKE '%s3%')) AND grp='usable' AND needs_card=0 AND identity_basis='stated' AND duplicate_of IS NULL AND rid IN (SELECT rid FROM claim WHERE kind='has-free-tier' AND num=1)

needs.title: Free or trial GPU time
needs.scope: Compute offers that mention GPU in their category or text and are usable or trial. Read the free tier line for hours per week or month.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='compute' AND grp IN ('usable','trial') AND (category LIKE '%GPU%' OR rno IN (SELECT docid FROM text_fts WHERE text_fts MATCH 'offer:gpu')) AND duplicate_of IS NULL AND coalesce(summary,'') NOT LIKE 'no free %' AND coalesce(summary,'') NOT LIKE 'no published free %' AND coalesce(summary,'') NOT LIKE 'no perpetual free %'

needs.title: Free compute with no card
needs.scope: Usable compute offers whose stated identity requirement is not a card.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE topic='compute' AND grp='usable' AND needs_card=0 AND identity_basis='stated' AND duplicate_of IS NULL AND coalesce(summary,'') NOT LIKE 'no free %' AND coalesce(summary,'') NOT LIKE 'no published free %' AND coalesce(summary,'') NOT LIKE 'no perpetual free %'

needs.title: Cheapest rented machines by USD a month
needs.scope: Compute offers with a parsed monthly USD price, cheapest first. A rented machine is a service; nothing here is hardware to buy.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, usd_month FROM record WHERE topic='compute' AND usd_month IS NOT NULL AND grp <> 'dead' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Inference APIs with no card and no phone
needs.scope: Usable model-inference endpoints, in the inference topic or categorised as inference elsewhere, whose stated identity needs neither a card nor a phone.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE (topic='inference' OR category LIKE '%inference%') AND grp='usable' AND needs_card=0 AND needs_phone=0 AND identity_basis='stated' AND duplicate_of IS NULL AND coalesce(summary,'') NOT LIKE 'no free %' AND coalesce(summary,'') NOT LIKE 'no published free %' AND coalesce(summary,'') NOT LIKE 'no perpetual free %'

needs.title: Usable with no account at all
needs.scope: Usable offers in any topic whose identity requirement is anonymous.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE grp='usable' AND identity_kind='anonymous' AND identity_basis='stated' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Offers that name a crypto payment rail
needs.scope: Records whose payment or identity text names a cryptocurrency. Not a verdict on the offer.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, vorder FROM record WHERE crypto=1 AND grp <> 'dead' AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Debrid and retrieval services by monthly price
needs.scope: Debrid offers with a parsed monthly USD price, cheapest first, then the offers with no parsed price. An offer priced per TB and not per month is ranked in debrid-by-tb, because a price per TB and a price per month are not one unit.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, usd_month FROM record WHERE topic='debrid' AND grp IN ('usable','paid','trial') AND NOT (usd_month IS NULL AND usd_per_tb_month IS NOT NULL) AND duplicate_of IS NULL

needs.title: Debrid and retrieval services priced per TB
needs.scope: Debrid offers priced per TB-month and not per month, cheapest first. The offers with a monthly price are ranked in debrid-cheapest.
needs.sql: SELECT rid, usd_per_tb_month FROM record WHERE topic='debrid' AND grp IN ('usable','paid','trial') AND usd_month IS NULL AND usd_per_tb_month IS NOT NULL AND duplicate_of IS NULL
